info.name: Fabric of Space = Dynamic Foam
info.description:
The Fabric of Space = Dynamic Foam (Voronoi) with currents in the edge redistributing energy from one cell to other(s). Regulated by the acute angles:
< 90° = 0
> 90° = I
In this semi-solid/liquid structure numerical strings and closed knots can emerge.
